rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: Remove existing 6.5 foot by 36 foot wooden pier, two concrete piles and footings, 11 creosote piles, 4 foot and 7.5 inches by 30 foot grated aluminum ramp, and 11 foot by 56 foot concrete float. Install six 10 inch steel piles, and a four foot by 44 foot aluminum ramp and 8 foot by 60 foot float. Construct a six foot by 24 foot joint use pier with a 1.5 foot by 7 foot concrete shore mount with a 4 foot and 8 inch by 6 foot aluminum plate to transition between the pier and ground.
